title: -------------------------------------------------------------Bus Wellington to Napier | Travel with InterCity
lines: Catch an InterCity bus Wellington to Napier. Buses to Napier depart from Platform 10 of the Wellington Railway Station and arrive in Napier at the temporary InterCity Napier bus stop outside Woolworths Napier, 181 Station Street.

Travel from the cultural capital of Wellington to the sunny Hawke’s Bay region in Napier in just 6 hours and 15 minutes aboard an InterCity coach. With comfortable, daily services, you’ll pass through scenic vistas of the lower North Island.
Book online to secure great fares, with flexible ticketing options for all travellers.
Search for a bus from Wellington to Napier and book online with New Zealand's most popular national bus network.
How long is the trip? The journey from Wellington to Napier takes approximately 6 hours with regular breaks along the way.
Book your trip today to explore Napier’s Art Deco charm with InterCity!
